api_checks.description: F198 Prospect sign-up creates only a prospect account with a hashed password: body {username:'meera.nair', password:'synthetic-pass-123'}; role prospect, case_id null. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F199 Sign-up rejects invalid input and taken usernames including staff names: username admin1 (or any existing name); invalid input is 422 naming the field. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F200 A role in the sign-up body cannot create staff: body also carries role admin; response role is prospect and GET /api/v1/admin/users with that token is 403. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F201 A signed-in prospect registers a lead linked to the account; a second lead is refused: account token that already has a case; the first lead from the account is 201 and links the case. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F202 Login returns the linked case and a token bound to it: prospect account; case_id null before a lead and the linked case id after; another case is 403. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F203 Prospect-account tokens die with the account and forged ones are rejected: token of a deactivated prospect account or a forged prospect token for an unknown user. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_signup_api.py and e2e/live/ui-signup.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.
